en.summary: KuCoin offers new users a Futures Position Airdrop worth 100 USDT after a first futures trade of 100+ USDT volume. Only brand-new registered users can join, and the most you can withdraw from the position is $5 USDT in profit.
steps: Join the campaign through the official announcement link from a social channel (for example Telegram, X, Reddit, Discord): without it you are not eligible.
Register a new KuCoin account. The text gives no deadline.
Place your first futures trade with 100+ USDT volume. The text gives no deadline for this step.

payout.when: The rules do not say when the reward arrives, whether it must be claimed by a date, or how long it stays valid.
payout.form: A Futures Position Airdrop of 100 USDT (per the headline). This is not free cash: if the position takes a loss you owe nothing, and on closing it you can withdraw at most $5 USDT of profit (5% of the position value).
payout.how: The rules do not say where the position appears or whether you must claim it manually.

watch: You must use the official announcement link from social channels, otherwise you are not eligible.
Withdrawal is limited to $5 USDT of profit. The 100 USDT in the headline does not mean you can withdraw 100 USDT.
The line about zero-fee trades (“Transaction volume does not count towards zero-fee transactions”) is unclear. It may mean they don't count; ask KuCoin to confirm.
Wash trading (fake volume), mass account registrations and unusual trading patterns lead to disqualification.
The rules mention no fees, countries or KYC. KuCoin keeps the right of final interpretation.

faq.q: If the position loses, do I owe KuCoin?
faq.a: Under the rules, no: if the position takes a loss, you owe nothing.

faq.q: Do I get 100 USDT on my balance?
faq.a: No, by the text it is a position, not money on your balance. You can withdraw at most $5 USDT of profit after closing it.

faq.q: I've used KuCoin before. Can I join?
faq.a: No, this activity is only for brand-new registered users.
The text provided does not mention KYC. Check KuCoin's requirements before registering.
No. Apple Inc. is not a sponsor and is not affiliated with this event.
